svg.title: Effective potential
svg.desc: Curves of the effective potential for four angular momenta.

cc:Work.dc:creator: Nan, hongdam.net
cc:Work.dc:description: computed by tools/figures.py from the equation it shows

svg.text: Effective potential for a massive particle around a Schwarzschild black hole
V(r) = √((1 − 2M/r)(1 + L²/r²)) — a particle with energy E moves where E ≥ V; a dip holds an orbit, a rim lets it fall over
L = √12 M: the well and the rim meet — r = 6M
L = 4.0M: a well at r ≈ 12M, a rim at r ≈ 4M
